A great rooftop restaurant.
Feb 2025 • Couples
My husband and I had a wonderful meal at this great roof top restaurant last night. It has a lovely ambience- relaxed and slightly bohemian with great views.
The samoas were delicious as an appetizer followed by a flavoursome paneer masala for myself and a prawn curry for my husband. The nan breads were light and airy.
The staff were very friendly attentive and helpful, advising us on our choice of dishes. We didn't want to end up with something that was too spicy for us to enjoy the flavours.
I would recommend this restaurant for it's excellent food, ambience and great service.

absolutely loved it ❤️ definitely worth enjoying the experience 👍🏻😃
Dec 2024 • Solo
During my stay in Nha Trang I ate 4 or 5 times at the Vandana restaurant and they never disappointed.

The lovely and highly professional owner is Indian but the chefs and staff are all probably locals so maybe not 100% "authentic" Indian but definitely close enough... and truly good as well as very fairly priced.

The location on a rooftop (7th floor) is great as well as the "open" space the guests can enjoy. While there I also liked the music. Not too loud, just right 👍🏻❤️

Only a few staff member have a good command of English. The young Vietnamese gentleman visibly in charge (supervisor?) is not only professional, super welcoming and happy to assist, advise but speaks perfect English.

I had a vew version of the chicken tikka masala (from mild to spicy to very spicy) and loved all of them. The extra spicy is more about spices than the tomatoes, onions delicious sauce.. but if you are after a hot dish go for it 😁👹

I loved it at the Vandana. The only nuisance I suffered there 2 times was guests related. I happen to enjoy dinner and the same very noisy party of white English speaking people (8 to 10) showed up... on two occasions (bad coincidence from my perspective ;-)... most males smoking.. and loud well beyond common sense, not even to mention "good manners" and respect for other guests...
